About Claimball

Claimball is a casual duel game where you play against an AI rival on a notebook-style grid. It is made by ipe() (ipe Studio), and it is coming soon to iOS and Android. There is no store page or release date yet.

How a match works

  • The board is a notebook grid of 6 by 10 tiles.
  • The tile where the ball bounces becomes the land of the player who hit it. If you miss, you lose land.
  • Hit the ball with the center of your paddle for a smash, which claims 3 tiles at once.
  • A match takes about 90 seconds. The final seconds are a showdown.

Rivals

You always play against an AI rival. There are 6 AI rivals across 2 leagues at launch, with more planned in updates.

Price and ads

Claimball is free to try, and a single purchase unlocks the full game. There are no ads and no subscription. The price will be announced closer to launch.

Platforms

Claimball is coming soon to iOS and Android. Follow the journal for notes from the making of the game, and see Support if you want to write to us.

Who makes it

Claimball is made by Davy Kim (ipe Studio). Contact: ipe.haven@gmail.com.
